parsed.rationale: All three types — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each independently defines an identical `displayName` computed property at line 41 of their respective files. Because the implementations are exactly duplicated (query: `function-duplicates-exact`) and none of the records carry any restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), the duplication is unambiguously unintentional. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a protocol `BlendModeDisplayable` with a default implementation of `displayName` in a protocol extension, allowing all three enum types to conform and delete their individual implementations. A PAT is preferred over a plain protocol-with-default-impl here because the blend mode types are likely enums with raw values, making a constrained protocol extension (e.g., `where Self: RawRepresentable, Self.RawValue == String`) the most precise and zero-boilerplate solution.
